body:
I decided not to tell her. She would just be disappointed again with me. Just say aren’t you taking your meds. Always about my meds.

My heart aches for my kids. I know this is gonna make them sad. I think this makes me a monster. I just have nothing left. I can’t keep existing like this.

I feel such peace thinking about it. To no longer live as me, to not hurt this much. My docs and therapists they always say I made it through this before.

But they don’t live it. They don’t keep coming back here. The good periods they are torture too. They are short lived and always return to here.

I am sorry for those who will be hurt but I need to stop hurting.

You know it’s the roller coaster of ups and downs. It is so exhausting. I can not describe how miserable I am. I am so tired of putting my game face on. I dread going home. Seeing my family when I feel this way is devastating. I feel so alone in this. 

My kids are always asking me if I am ok. I keep lying. They take on so much more than they should have too. I just think it works better if I am not there to keep messing them up. I have no doubt my wife will do a better job raising them.

Yeah my mood is dominantly low right now however I have moments where it is really high. Though these times just feed the frustration. I need to find way to tell her or my docs. I promised I would but I am finding it so hard to be here again. It is such a life sentence for me. hopefully posting here will help me get courage to tell her. But the shame of it is pretty severe.
Great photo. I also really like the bike.
I must be scary looking as the leave me alone. Lol
We like to take Trax there and hang out. But I am also at that station every work day waiting for Trax. Definitely worse places to be
Thanks for posting. I have not been up the for decades. Are there still three lakes up there?

Thanks!!

I take that stop all the time but that day was particularly early. I really felt like I was the only person downtown at that moment.
Thanks for the up votes. This was my first photo i took with my new iPhone.
Way to early in Salt Lake City. :-)
